//: write-target-guard config. Copy to ~/.claude/write-target-guard.config.json (Windows: C:\Users\<you>\.claude\write-target-guard.config.json) and edit for your machine. This file is the TRUST ANCHOR: it is read from your home directory, never from a repo, and the guard itself denies edits to it unless the content carries `guard-ack: guard-config`. All paths are matched case-insensitively with backslash separators; a trailing backslash on `primary` excludes sibling directories (primary-foo). If this file is MISSING or MALFORMED the guard fails OPEN but LOUD (a systemMessage warns that Write/Edit are unguarded). To turn the guard OFF deliberately and silently, set "enabled": false or use an empty "repos": [] — those are the only silent states.

hints.primaryLabel: PRIMARY worktree (holds the deployed line; merges land here, code work does not)
hints.worktreeAddExample: git -C c:\dev\my-project worktree add -b <type>/<scope> c:\dev\my-project-<slug> origin/<base-branch>
